# compute_void_volume_from_results_lattice { #mofography.compute.compute_void_volume_from_results_lattice }

<span class="mg-tag mg-tag-alternate">alternate</span> Voxel void volume with lattice accessibility; comparison to winding variant. Use `compute_void_volume_from_results_winding` instead.

```python
compute.compute_void_volume_from_results_lattice(
    results_dict,
    mat_atoms,
    probe_radius=None,
    return_details=False,
    variant='v2',
)
```

Void volume (voxel) with lattice accessibility.
